question: List the card names with value that cost more converted mana for the face.
evidence: more converted mana for the face refers to Max(faceConvertedManaCost);
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT name AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY faceConvertedManaCost) AS __r FROM cards) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT name FROM cards ORDER BY faceConvertedManaCost LIMIT 1

d.request: List the names and face converted mana cost values of all cards with the highest face converted mana cost, including every card tied for that value.
d.sql: SELECT name, faceConvertedManaCost FROM cards WHERE faceConvertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(faceConvertedManaCost) FROM cards);

b.request: List the names and face converted mana cost of every card whose face converted mana cost equals the maximum, including all ties
b.sql: SELECT name, faceConvertedManaCost FROM cards WHERE faceConvertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(faceConvertedManaCost) FROM cards);
